Product:{\"sku\":\"7100125794\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Some guys fall in love. These guys fall obsessed.

Yandere Temptation is a dark visual novel where every tender moment hides something that goes way too far.

Three anime boys. Three kinds of love that cross every line. And you, caught between attraction and something much harder to name, choosing how deep you want to go.

The quiet one who already knows your schedule. The volatile one who loses it when you so much as glance at someone else. The calculated one with a perfect smile and a plan you weren't supposed to find out about.

Each date pulls you further into their world, and every choice feeds something neither of you can fully control.

A companion watches from the outside. They see the red flags you've decided to ignore. They warn you. The rest is on you.


Features:

● THREE YANDERE ROUTES: The silent observer, the emotional explosion, the cold strategist. Each one a different flavor of dangerous devotion.

● NARRATIVE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Push deeper into the obsession or try to slow it down. Every decision reshapes where things end up.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Some romantic, some dramatic, some genuinely disturbing. What you get depends on how much you gave.

● AN OUTSIDE VOICE: Your companion sees what you won't admit. Their warnings get harder to ignore the further you go.

● DARK EMOTIONAL STORYTELLING: Love bombing, quiet control, jealousy that burns. The full yandere experience across every route and every scene.


You told yourself you could handle it. Then he looked at you like that.
Download now and find out exactly how far you'll let this go.
